text:
maria: Morning — trying to provision a tiny GPU nodepool in europe-west8 (private VPC). Need guidance on instance type & quotas. Goal: low-latency internal inference, 2-4 nodes. h100/a100 availability looks thin in this region.

devon: what workload? batch embeddings or low-latency replicas?

maria: low-latency inference for search, seq len ~1024. Target is 2 replicas of a quantized 7B-ish model (8GB VRAM min). Autoscaler: min 0 max 6. Prefer spot for cost but need fallback to guaranteed for SLA.

liam: fyi europe-west8 GPU SKUs are limited. I ran `gcloud compute accelerator-types list --zones europe-west8-*` — only A2 and T4 types show up. Might need a quota/sku enable ticket to get A100/H100. Also external static IP quota is 25 by default in this org.

anika: if external IPs are constrained, we should use Cloud NAT + internal LB. NAT costs apply but saves per-node static IPs. Alternatively a small NVA with SNAT.

maria: rough nodepool YAML I'm thinking about:

```yaml
apiVersion: container.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1
kind: GKEClusterNodePool
spec:
  name: eu8-gpu-compact
  autoscaling:
    minNodeCount: 0
    maxNodeCount: 6
  config:
    machineType: n1-standard-16
    accelerators:
      - acceleratorType: nvidia-tesla-a100
        acceleratorCount: 1
    taints:
      - key: "gpu-workload"
        value: "dedicated"
        effect: "NO_SCHEDULE"
  nodeLabels:
    workload: "edge-infer"
  preemptible: true
```

devon: small nit: provider API uses `spot` not `preemptible` in some clouds. Also set evictionGracePeriod to 10m. Avoid local-ssd unless you need it — it burns quota. :thumbsup:

liam: add note — mark critical model pods with `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict: "false"` (on pods) so CA won't kill them when scaling down. For guaranteed fallback, keep 2 nodes in a separate pool.

infra-bot: @maria opened support ticket INC-4882 with cloud provider for GPU quota enablement in europe-west8. Ticket link: https://cloudsupport.example/INC-4882

anika: cost callout: Cloud NAT + 1 static IP + small egress will be ~ $600/mo estimate for baseline. Additional reserved GPU quota increases may have lead times.

maria: question — can we do mixed pools: 2 guaranteed nodes (always on) + a spot pool autoscaling to 4? Want pattern for taints/tolerations to prefer guaranteed for critical pods.

devon: yes — recommended pattern: two nodepools. `eu8-gpu-guaranteed` min=2 max=2 (no-spot), `eu8-gpu-burst` min=0 max=4 (spot). Add label `pool=guaranteed` and use `nodeAffinity` + tolerations on critical deployments.

liam: sample pod spec bits:

```yaml
spec:
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - key: pool
            operator: In
            values: [guaranteed]
  tolerations:
  - key: "gpu-workload"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "dedicated"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  annotations:
    cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict: "false"
```

maria: perfect. I'll draft infra PR and attach the support ticket. Please flag if there are quota blockers (external IPs, vCPU, GPU accelerators).

anika: I'll check org quotas and update INC-4882. If quota's slow, fallback is to deploy a CPU-only smaller model until GPUs are available.

maria: thanks all — will post PR link here when ready. :heart:
